observed_behavior: Primer documentation describes inactive as visually unavailable yet still interactive for contextual explanation, whereas disabled buttons may not be clicked or keyboard navigated; inactive can support an explanatory dialog.
context: W02 action-controls pilot; documented design-system behavior, not universal recommendation
limitations: This distinction is system-specific and should not be conflated with aria-disabled or native disabled semantics.
notes: Source documentation inspected; no independent end-user usability testing
